name: Upstash Box

modes.label: Pay as You Go, Small box (2 vCPU / 4 GB), active CPU core-hours
modes.note: $0.10 per active CPU core-hour on the Small size (the per-core rate rises with box size: Small $0.10, Medium $0.20, Large $0.40). Resolved reading: price is per core-hour of actual CPU consumed (FAQ: 100% of 2 cores for 1 h = $0.20, 10% of 1 core for 1 h = $0.01; vendor blog: 0.167 core-h x $0.10 = $0.017). Full load = 2 x $0.10 = $0.20/h. RAM free. Idle (0 CPU) running box costs $0; box auto-freezes after 6 h idle (Free: 1 h), storage keeps billing at $0.10/GB-month. Disk 5 GB max. Granularity/minimum unpublished. Basis check 2026-09-28: 'You are billed based on how much CPU your code actually consumes, measured in core-hours'; 'When a standard box is idle with no CPU usage, no charges apply'; plan table 'Idle Timeout 1 hour' (Free) / '6 hours' (PAYG) (https://upstash.com/pricing/box). No memory meter, so ram_gib_h 0 and ram_basis alloc (nothing to scale).

modes.commit_note: keepAlive: true box never pauses; flat $8/month is the only charge for that box (CPU at any utilisation + its storage included). Proration for boxes created/deleted mid-month is unpublished.
modes.label: Fixed / Keep-Alive Small box, always on ($8/box/month)
modes.note: hour = $8/730. Break-even vs PAYG Small: $8 / ($0.10 x 2 cores x util) = 40 h/month at 100% CPU, 133 h at 30%. Fair-use limits at sustained 100% CPU unpublished.

modes.commit_note: Keep C persistent keep-alive boxes and reuse them for sessions; you pay C x $8/month regardless of hours used. Tiers are a coarse approximation of N x $8 (rounds C up to the next tier).
modes.label: Keep-Alive Small fleet sized to peak concurrency (part-time use)
modes.note: Valid only if each session fits one Small box (max 2 vCPU / 4 GB per box: sessions cannot span boxes) and sessions can reuse long-lived boxes (state carries over between sessions unless you clean it). Real cost is exactly ceil(C) x $8/month.

plans.name: Free
plans.note: Hard cap of 5 active CPU-hours/month (= $0.50 at the Small $0.10 rate), Small boxes only, 10 concurrent, idle freeze after 1 h, $1/month LLM budget then API returns 400. Storage free. Not an overage plan: usage beyond 5 CPU-h is blocked, not billed. Verifier 2026-09-28: marked trial_only so the engine never picks it: it is a hard cap (5 CPU-h, blocked not billed), so pricing it as fee 0 + usage minus $0.50 would understate any workload that exceeds the cap.

plans.name: Pay as You Go
plans.note: No fee. 1,000 concurrent boxes default (soft quota, raisable on request). Idle freeze after 6 h. Keep-alive (Fixed) boxes are bought per box under this same account ($8/$16/$32). $100/month LLM budget for the built-in agent, then BYOK or contact.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.note: Custom sizes, limits, prices, regions; dedicated support. Unpublished.

extras.price: Included up to $1/month (Free) or $100/month (PAYG/Fixed); beyond that BYOK or contact sales

perf_source: ComputeSDK (github.com/computesdk/benchmarks results/): cold 445.15 ms (2026-08-07) and burst 5,633.01 ms (2026-09-25) with ephemeral:true at SDK default size; dax 53.4 s (2026-09-25) on size "large" (8 cores / 16 GB; guest saw 48 host CPUs aarch64). Pay-as-you-go and keep-alive are the same boxes. No HPC result.
caveats: 'Active CPU hour' resolved as a core-hour of actual consumption priced by box size (Small $0.10, Medium $0.20, Large $0.40 per core-hour): the FAQ ($0.20 for 100% of 2 cores for 1 h; $0.01 for 10% of 1 core) and Upstash's own comparison blog (0.167 core-h x $0.10 = $0.017 on a 2 vCPU box) multiply core-hours by the size rate. The FAQ/blog only give Small examples, so the Medium/Large per-core rate is the table value applied per core (not confirmed by a worked example). Alternative readings: uniform $0.10/core-h (Medium full load $0.40/h) or price per box-hour at full load (Medium $0.20/h = $0.05/core-h). The engine uses the per-core size rate (most expensive, $0.80/h for Medium at 100%).

Active basis: engine bills vcpu x util x rate using the rounded box vCPU count (e.g. a 1 vCPU workload on a Small box is billed as 2 x util); reality bills only cores actually consumed, so small workloads are slightly overestimated.

Keep-alive is cheaper than PAYG even for part-time use once a box is active more than ~67 h/month at 30% CPU (Medium: $16 / (4 x 0.3 x $0.20)). The keepalive-fleet pool modes approximate a persistent fleet of C boxes (tiers 1/5/10/25/50/100/250/500/1000); real cost is exactly C x $8/$16/$32. Engine must respect each fleet mode's max_vcpu/max_ram_gib (one session per box).

Keep-alive proration (create/delete mid-month) and fair-use limits at sustained 100% CPU are unpublished. Whether snapshots taken from a keep-alive box are covered by the flat price is unclear ('no separate storage charges' on that box); modeled as billed at $0.10/GB-month.

Storage $0.10/GB-month applies to 'all data on disk, including snapshots', presumably actual used GB (not the 5/10/20 GB limit); the pricing card's '5 GB Included Storage' is read as the disk size, not a free allowance (included_disk_gib 0). Paused/frozen boxes keep billing storage; retention limit unpublished.
No RAM charge on any plan. Idle-but-running boxes cost $0 CPU; the idle timeout (6 h PAYG / 1 h Free) only affects wake latency, not cost.
Egress/ingress not published (null); docs cite 22.5 Gbps network per host. No public IPv4 (HTTPS preview URLs + SSH gateway only).
Billing granularity and minimum billed time unpublished (null).
Single region: AWS us-east-1. Enterprise can request other regions.

Custom Docker images 'coming soon'; environments are reused via filesystem snapshots (restorable into a different size). EphemeralBox variant (exec+files only, TTL max 3 days, no agent/git/public URL/pause) has no separate price published; assumed same active-CPU rates.

arm64 set true because the computesdk DAX run reports an aarch64 host (48 logical CPUs / 185 GiB visible inside the container); features research lists x86_64. The in-box CPU/RAM view shows host resources, so the cgroup cap vs billed cores is unverified.
Keep-Alive pricing moved from a tooltip to its own 'Fixed' plan column on 2026-09-27 (upstash-web PR #662); no price change.
perf from benchmarks.json (computesdk cold start 445 ms median, burst 5,633 ms median at 100 concurrency, DAX 53.4 s). No hpc CPU benchmark.

Verified 2026-09-28 against https://upstash.com/pricing/box.md and https://upstash.com/docs/box/overall/pricing: sizes, $0.1/$0.2/$0.4 per active CPU hour, $8/$16/$32 keep-alive, $0.10/GB-month storage incl. snapshots, 1 h / 6 h idle timeouts, 10 / 1,000 concurrency all confirmed. Per-core-by-size reading still only evidenced by Small-rate examples.

fleet.tiers: Free 10; PAYG and fixed keep-alive 1,000 default; higher soft quota by contacting provider.
fleet.notes: 10 fits Free within 5 CPU-hours/month; 50/300/1,000 fit paid quota. 1,000 is a raisable soft limit, not hard product cap. LLM budget separate from concurrency; no review turnaround stated.
